study_note: Single-seed exploratory 14-million-decision Humanoid Walk base-v2 derived from the strongest base-v1 training recipe. It uses J=8, N=32, H=3, and G=1, yielding 768 imagined transitions and eight joint actor, critic, and automatic-temperature update slots per real action. The outer and inner target-network tau values are both 0.01, and the outer and inner automatic-temperature learning rates are both 3e-4. Ordinary controller evaluation, paired outer-versus-fresh-inner real-environment evaluation, real-environment Q-versus-MC value evaluation, sparse value-equivalence MC diagnostics, value-equivalence training loss, and paired imagined diagnostic rollouts are disabled so the run focuses on training performance. Portable periodic and final model saves are disabled. This remains a single-seed exploratory run and supports no confidence, significance, or confirmatory claim.
